welcome.text: Welcome to Traffic Light Patterns! Watch the lights and guess what comes next!

instructions.text: Look at the traffic lights. One is missing! Press the right color to fill in the pattern.

correct_1.text: That's the right light! Great job!

wrong_1.text: Oops! That's not the right color.

wrong_2.text: Not quite! Look at the pattern again.

wrong_3.text: Try again! Which light comes next?

level_up.text: Level up! The patterns are getting trickier!

win.text: Time's up! What a great score!

try_again.text: Good effort! Want to try again?

teach_ab.text: The AB pattern has two colors that take turns! Red, yellow, red, yellow — see how they switch back and forth?

teach_abc.text: The ABC pattern uses all three colors in order! Red, yellow, green, then start over!

teach_abb.text: In the ABB pattern, one color comes once, then another color comes twice! Red, yellow, yellow, red, yellow, yellow!

teach_aabb.text: In the AABB pattern, we see two of each color! Red, red, yellow, yellow, then start over!

teach_aab.text: The AAB pattern has a pair of one color, then a single of another! Red, red, yellow, red, red, yellow!

teach_abba.text: ABBA is a palindrome — it reads the same forwards and backwards! Red, yellow, yellow, red!

teach_aabc.text: The AABC pattern starts with a double, then two different singles! Red, red, yellow, green, then repeat!

hint_used.text: Here's a hint! Look at the pattern carefully.

pattern_master.text: You're a pattern master! You learned so many patterns today!
